channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump hails progress but warned Iran of ‘hard hit’ if no deal reached
item.description: US President Donald Trump says progress with Iran has been made, but warned Iran of 'hard hit' if no deal reached.

item.title: Japan tests US-Tomahawk missile as it moves away from Post-WWII status
item.description: Japan tested a US-Tomahawk cruise missile, launching from their Chokai warship in the Pacific Ocean on July 29.

item.title: Explosions across Kyiv as Russian missiles strike Ukraine’s capital
item.description: At least one person has been killed after a Russian ballistic missile attack on Ukraine’s capital Wednesday morning.

item.title: North Korea’s Kim Yo Jong issues military threat over Japan missile test
item.description: The powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has accused Japan of moving beyond a defensive posture.

item.title: Trump says Iran will be 'hit very hard' if Hormuz Strait not open soon as oil prices fall
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent both announced talks had progressed to allow shipments to resume.

item.title: Mass funeral in Gaza for 112 Palestinians killed in 2023 Israeli strike
item.description: The bodies - belonging to members of two extended families - have only recently been recovered from under rubble in Gaza City.

item.title: The avalanche that killed a climbing legend - and a generation of record-setting guides
item.description: Their fellow guides say their deaths in Pakistan dealt a devastating blow to Nepal's mountaineering community.

item.title: Mysterious elephant deaths in Kenya raise questions around pesticides
item.description: A wave of Kenyan elephant deaths has been blamed on pesticides, but experts tell the BBC they are doubtful.
